User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.
Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.

description: Participants can understand the next responsible engineering activity and prepare its inputs, prerequisites, and required governed records while preserving isolated use, review independence, and actual continuation authority.

includes: Scope-aware handoffs and corrective routing using current context and applicable assessment basis.
Conditional governed recording through the supported procedure and truthful operation outcomes.
Distinguishing local progress, readiness, governed completion, and authorized external handoff.

Stage-specific readiness, owner-directed corrections, checked milestone progression without milestone approval, one whole-change review gate with multiple attempts, and coordinated adoption that preserves historical judgments.
excludes: Storage-format implementation or a new record version.
Automatic continuation after an isolated invocation.
Renewing stale evidence or granting authority merely by recording a result.
